# /sync — Regenerate AI Tool Configurations

Regenerates all AI tool configurations from the AgentKit Forge spec. Renders templates for every active render target (Claude, Cursor, Copilot, Windsurf, Codex, Gemini, Cline, Roo, Warp) and updates generated files in the repository.

## Usage

```
/sync [--only <target>] [--overwrite] [--diff] [--no-clean]
```

## How to Sync

Run from the repository root:

```bash
pnpm --dir .agentkit retort:sync
```

Or directly:

```bash
node .agentkit/engines/node/src/cli.mjs sync
```

## Flags

| Flag              | Effect                                                                                               |
| ----------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| `--only <target>` | Sync only one platform (claude, cursor, copilot, windsurf, codex, gemini, cline, roo, warp, ai, mcp) |
| `--overwrite`     | Overwrite project-owned (scaffold-once) files                                                        |
| `--diff`          | Preview changes without writing                                                                      |
| `--no-clean`      | Keep orphaned files that would normally be removed                                                   |

## Post-Sync Checklist

1. Review `git diff` for changed files
2. Run `/validate` to verify generated outputs are well-formed
3. Commit the regenerated files

## When to Sync

- After modifying any file in `.agentkit/spec/`
- After updating Retort version
- After enabling or disabling features
- When CI drift check fails

## Rules

1. Always review the diff before committing regenerated output
2. Never edit generated files directly — they will be overwritten on next sync
3. Commit spec changes and regenerated output together (or in two atomic commits)

## Project Context

- **Repository**: retort
- **Default Branch**: main
